Package neqsim.process.equipment.separator.entrainment

Class EntrainmentProviderRegistry

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.separator.entrainment.EntrainmentProviderRegistry
public final class EntrainmentProviderRegistry extends Object
Registry / loader for EnhancedEntrainmentProvider implementations.

Discovery is delegated to ServiceLoader: every JAR on the classpath that contains a META-INF/services/neqsim.process.equipment.separator.entrainment.EnhancedEntrainmentProvider file contributes its providers automatically. The built-in provider BuiltInSevenStageProvider is registered through this same mechanism so the lookup path is uniform; private plug-ins (for example the Equinor π-number plug-in eqn-pi-v1) are picked up only when their JAR is on the classpath.

Usage on a separator: 

 separator.setEntrainmentProvider("eqn-pi-v1");
If the requested id is not registered, find(String) throws IllegalStateException so the caller fails loudly rather than silently falling back to a different correlation.

    • find

      public static EnhancedEntrainmentProvider find(String id)
      Looks up a registered provider by id.
      Parameters:
      id - the provider id, e.g. "neqsim-7stage" or "eqn-pi-v1"; must not be null
      Returns:
      the registered provider with the supplied id
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if id is null
      IllegalStateException - if no provider with the supplied id is registered (typically because the providing JAR is not on the classpath)
